arxiv-2012-00443.title: Lack of practical identifiability may hamper reliable predictions in COVID-19 epidemic models
arxiv-2012-00443.creator: L. Gallo, M. Frasca, V. Latora, G. Russo
arxiv-2012-00443.description: Abstract This paper introduces a general framework to quantify the reliability of the predictions of a dynamical model in the presence of unmeasurable variables, and presents an application to COVID-19. Compartmental models are widely adopted to describe and predict the spreading of infectious diseases. The unknown parameters of such models need to be estimated from the data.

arxiv-2212-03479.title: SCATTERING OF NEUTRINOS BY A ROTATING BLACK HOLE ACCOUNTING FOR THE ELECTROWEAK INTERACTION WITH AN ACCRETION DISK
arxiv-2212-03479.creator: MAXIM DVORNIKOV
arxiv-2212-03479.description: Abstract We study spin effects in the neutrino gravitational scattering by a supermassive black hole with a magnetized accretion disk having a finite thickness. We exactly describe the propagation of ultrarelativistic neutrinos on null geodesics and solve the spin precession equation along each neutrino trajectory.

arxiv-2307-16777.title: The Perturbed Full Two-Body Problem: Application to Post-DART Didymos
arxiv-2307-16777.creator: Alex J. Meyer, Harrison F. Agrusa, Derek C. Richardson, R. Terik Daly, Oscar Fuentes-Muñoz, Masatoshi Hirabayashi, Patrick Michel, Colby C. Merrill, Ryota Nakano, Andrew F. Cheng, Brent Barbee, Olivier S. Barnouin, Steven R. Chesley, Carolyn M. Ernst, Ioannis Gkolias, Nicholas A. Moskovitz, Shantanu
arxiv-2307-16777.description: Abstract With the successful impact of the NASA DART spacecraft in the Didymos-Dimorphos binary asteroid system, we provide an initial analysis of the post-impact perturbed binary asteroid dynamics. To compare our simulation results with observations, we introduce a set of “observable elements” calculated using only the physical separation of the binary asteroid, rather than traditional Keplerian elements.

arxiv-2311-01462.title: Idempotent Generative Network
arxiv-2311-01462.creator: Assaf Shocher Amil Dravid Yossi Gandelsman Inbar Mosseri Michael Rubinstein Alexei A. Efros UC Berkeley Google Research
arxiv-2311-01462.description: Abstract We propose a new approach for generative modeling based on training a neural network to be idempotent. An idempotent operator is one that can be applied sequentially without changing the result beyond the initial application, namely f ⁡ ( f ⁡ ( z ) ) = f ⁡ ( z ) f(f(z))=f(z) .

arxiv-2406-17255.title: MPCoder : Multi-user Personalized Code Generator with Explicit and Implicit Style Representation Learning
arxiv-2406-17255.creator: Zhenlong Dai, Chang Yao, Wenkang Han, Ying Yuan, Zhipeng Gao, Jingyuan Chen
arxiv-2406-17255.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated great potential for assisting developers in their daily development. However, most research focuses on generating correct code, how to use LLMs to generate personalized code has seldom been investigated. To bridge this gap, we proposed MPCoder ( M ulti-user P ersonalized Code Generato r ) to generate personalized code for multiple users.

arxiv-2412-08249.title: The Vanishing of the Non-linear Static Love Number of Kerr Black Holes and the Role of Symmetries
arxiv-2412-08249.creator: A. Riotto
arxiv-2412-08249.description: Abstract We investigate the tidal response of Kerr black holes in four-dimensional spacetimes subjected to external gravitational fields. Using the Ernst formalism and Weyl coordinates, we analyze the non-linear tidal deformation of rotating black holes and demonstrate that their static tidal Love numbers vanish at all orders of the external tidal field.

arxiv-2602-02884.title: Resolving the Tachocline using Inversion of Rotational Splitting Derived from Fitting Very Long and Long Time Series
arxiv-2602-02884.creator: Sylvain G. Korzennik, Antonio Eff-Darwich
arxiv-2602-02884.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Sylvain G. Korzennik, Antonio Eff-Darwich. We use rotation splittings derived from very long and long time series, namely 25.2, 12.6 and 6.3 year long, computed by Korzennik 2023 independent methodology to characterize the solar tachocline and its variation with latitude and time. We use two different inversion methodologies and a model of the tachocline to derive its position, width and the amplitude of the radial shear.

pmc-11438750.title: The association between introduction of the micro-axial flow pump Impella in hospitals and in-hospital mortality in patients treated with extracorporeal membrane oxygenation: interrupted time-series analyses
pmc-11438750.creator: Jun Nakata, Hiroyuki Ohbe, Toru Takiguchi, Yuji Nishimoto, Mikio Nakajima, Yusuke Sasabuchi, Toshiaki Isogai, Hiroki Matsui, Takeshi Yamamoto, Shoji Yokobori, Kuniya Asai, Hideo Yasunaga
pmc-11438750.description: BackgroundThe micro-axial flow pump Impella, a new mechanical circulatory device for cardiogenic shock, is still only available in a limited number of hospitals, due to the facility certification requirements and insufficient evidence of the benefit of introducing Impella in hospitals.

pmc-12622352.title: Exosomal miR-29a-3p derived from bone marrow stromal cells suppresses malignant behavior of NSCLC by regulating DNMT3A/JAK2/STAT3 axis
pmc-12622352.creator: Chao Su, Xiaoliang Han, Kang Zhang
pmc-12622352.description: MicroRNAs (miRNAs) can be transported to tumor cells through exosomes secreted by bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells (BMSC-Exos) and exert regulatory functions within cells. Here, we aim to investigate the functional mechanism of miR-29a-3p carried by BMSC-Exos in the treatment of NSCLC.

pmc-12628066.title: An injectable hyaluronic acid–silanol hydrogel containing arginine and puerarin for immune modulation and enhanced diabetic wound healing
pmc-12628066.creator: Renwen Wan, Zhiheng Lin, Mowen Xu, Wei Luo, Hengjie Jia, Zhufeng Hu, Zhengyuan Fang, Junming Sun, Yisheng Chen, Shiyi Chen, Zhiwen Luo, Lei Yi, Zhijie Zhao
pmc-12628066.description: Diabetic wound healing is a significant complication of diabetes mellitus, characterized by prolonged healing times, heightened infection risks, and potential amputations, necessitating innovative therapeutic approaches. This study aims to evaluate the efficacy of a novel injectable hydrogel, AP@HA-Si InjGel, which combines hyaluronic acid, silanol, and bioactive compounds to promote wound healing in diabetic patients.

pmc-13342323.title: Risk factors for thrombosis in eosinophilia: A case-control study
pmc-13342323.creator: Dongfeng Liang, Zhengyuan Hu, Wencheng Sun, Xiaohui Ma, Xuewen Ren
pmc-13342323.description: Sustained eosinophilia can indicate a serious health issue and may elevate the risk of thrombosis. This study aimed to explore potential risk factors of thrombosis in eosinophilia. This case-control study enrolled patients with an absolute eosinophil count of ≥ 500 cells/µL at the First Medical Center of the Chinese People’s Liberation Army General Hospital between January 2010 and January 2022.

pmc-13594959.title: Multi-omics analyses reveal steroid hormone and antioxidant pathways regulating sperm storage capacity in female Muscovy ducks (Cairina moschata)
pmc-13594959.creator: Zhou Wu, Xiaohuan Chao, Zhiqiang Chang, Liming Lan, Xue Rong Ma, Weijian Zhu, Aijun Liu, Weiming Liang, Xiquan Zhang, Cheng Fang, Congliang Ji, Qingbin Luo
pmc-13594959.description: The duration of fertility in poultry is directly influenced by sperm store ability within specialized sperm storage tubules (SSTs) of the female uterovaginal junction (UVJ). Improving the duration of fertility reduces artificial insemination frequency, influencing animal welfare, and production costs. Here, we investigated physiological and multi-omic factors underlying sperm storage capacity in female Muscovy ducks (Cairina moschata).

pmc-13623567.title: Awareness, attitudes, and utilization of large language models among healthcare students in Saudi Arabia: a cross-sectional analysis
pmc-13623567.creator: Mohammed A. Almeshari, Osama A. Asiri, Ayedh D. Alahmari, Abdulrhman S. Alghamdi, Sulaiman S. Alsaif, Saad A. Alhammad, Yasser K. Bamogaddam, Malak Alowaisi, Ali M. Alasmari, Nowaf Y. Alobaidi, Faraj K. Alenezi, Khalid S. Alwadeai
pmc-13623567.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). IntroductionLarge language models (LLMs) such as ChatGPT are increasingly adopted in health professions education worldwide, yet evidence on their use among healthcare students in the Middle East remains limited.MethodsThis cross-sectional study assessed awareness, attitudes, and utilization of LLMs among healthcare students across Saudi Arabian universities using a self-administered online questionnaire, adapted from a previously published instrument, distributed to healthcare students at multiple Saudi universities between April and August 2025. Descriptive and inferential statistics were used to compare responses by sex.

pmc-13645949.title: Relationship between polypharmacy, sarcopenia and drug classes in hospitalized older patients
pmc-13645949.creator: Gorkem Turhan, Ahmet Yalcin, Busra Gokce, Volkan Atmis, Murat Varli
pmc-13645949.description: BackgroundSarcopenia and polypharmacy are common geriatric syndromes associated with adverse outcomes in older adults. Although previous studies have suggested a potential relationship between these conditions, the independent nature of this association remains unclear, particularly among hospitalized populations. Certain medication classes may also exert muscle-protective effects that could influence this relationship.
